title: New Merch Shop!
contentHtml:
Welcome to the one-stop shop for the food nerds in your life.

Over the past few months, the team here at JKLA World HQ has been working on a special new project: a merchandise shop! You can explore the shop now at shop.kenjilopezalt.com.

What Can You Expect?

We wanted this space to be the one-stop shop for the food nerds in your life (even—or especially—if that nerd is you). Direct from our own merchandise shop, you'll find tees, crewnecks, totes, hats, socks, and more.

But to really work the kitchen, we know you need more than that. That's why the shop website also includes links to buy:

  • All three of Kenji's books, which you can get signed and personalized 🔗

  • Collaboration products like the Kenji x Our Place Super Nitride Wok 🔗

  • Kenji's kitchen essentials—tools and ingredients that will make your time in the kitchen more joyful and delicious 🔗

  • And a guide to pantry and ingredient staples 🔗

Stay tuned for the holiday season—we'll have gift guides wrapped and ready for you, too!

Special thank you to David Hudson of Cinesaurus for the incredible merchandise designs and Kari Ashley of Mainstay Design for putting together the beautiful online shopping site!
